description: Defines the RpcServerTrusty class, a Trusty-specific RPC server implementation with methods for configuration, session management, and connection handling.

classes.name: RpcServerTrusty
classes.description: A Trusty-specific RPC server class managing TIPC channels and sessions.

classes.name: RpcServerTrusty::PortAcl
classes.description: Structure representing access control list for ports, including flags, UUIDs, and extra data.

classes.name: RpcServerTrusty::ChannelContext
classes.description: Context for each open TIPC channel, holding session and connection references.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates and initializes an RpcServerTrusty instance listening on a specified port.

methods.name: setProtocolVersion
methods.description: Sets the protocol version for the RPC server.

methods.name: setSupportedFileDescriptorTransportModes
methods.description: Configures supported file descriptor transport modes.

methods.name: setRootObject
methods.description: Sets the root binder object for the RPC server.

methods.name: setRootObjectWeak
methods.description: Sets the root binder object weakly.

methods.name: setPerSessionRootObject
methods.description: Sets a callback to provide per-session root objects.

methods.name: getRootObject
methods.description: Retrieves the current root binder object.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Returns a list of active RPC sessions.
